{{otheruses|walkthrough of the whole [[War in Kryta]]|the ''overarc'' [[quest]] and its walkthrough|The War in Kryta}} [[File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|thumb|256px|War in Kryta flow chart
(click to enlarge).]] == Overview/Prerequisites == {| style="margin: 0em auto 1em; " cellpadding="2" |- | [[File:Exclamation_Point_-_Red_Emblem.svg‎]] | style="text-align:left; width:100%;" | '''Attention:'''The following [[Beyond]] quest sequences require that your account includes both [[Prophecies]] and [[Eye of the North]]. The easiest way to meet all the prerequisites for the War in Kryta is to have finished EotN. |} The [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flow chart]] provides an overview of the various tasks, quests, and dialogues that make up the [[War in Kryta]] and the dialogues between [[Gwen]] and [[Lieutenant Thackeray|Thackeray]]. * To start ''WiK'', you must have completed one of the following sets of quests: ** From EotN, the primary quest sequences, [[Northern Allies]] and [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] ''or'' ** [[Hell's Precipice]] (from Prophecies) and [[Zinn's Task]]. * Further, you cannot begin the sequence if anyone in the party has already completed the War in Kryta. * To begin the dialogues leading to Thackeray preparing [[Thackeray's scavenger hunt|a Picnic for Gwen]], you must also complete [[A Good Deed.]] {{sic}} (or its [[Wintersday Cheer|2008-9 Wintersday equivalent]]) or [[Snowball Dominance]]. This quest is also needed to start the wanted quests in Lion's Arch keep. These two requisites are not explicitly displayed on the flowchart. == Order of quest chains == === War in Kryta === # To begin the WiK sequence, take [[the War in Kryta]] quest. # Witness the [[Trial of Zinn]]. Map to [[Vlox's Falls]] and talk to [[Chark]] just outside. (Prerequisite: completion of EotN ''or'' [[Zinn's Task]]) # Next, visit the [[Shining Blade camp]] in Southwestern [[Talmark Wilderness (War in Kryta)|Talmark Wilderness]]. Listen to the first set of [[War in Kryta dialogues|dialogues]] and rezone through [[Tears of the Fallen]] to trigger the next one. #* ''Dialogue 1:'' A scout brings [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 1 - A Grim Report|a grim report]]. #* ''Dialogue 2:'' Evennia and Livia leave to [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 2 - Search for Allies|search for allies]]. # Rezone one more time to the Shining Blade camp to unlock another dialogue: #* ''Dialogue 4:'' [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 4 - Livia Recruits Zinn|Livia Recruits Zinn]], which unlocks: #** [[Lion's Arch Keep]], which has #*** [[Wanted by the Shining Blade|Shining Blade Bounty]] quests. #*** Collectors for [[War Supplies]] and [[Confessor's Orders]] #** Hidden Asura lab in [[Divinity Coast (explorable area)|Divinity Coast]]. #** Escort missions for [[Courier Falken]]. # Complete [[Thackeray's scavenger hunt]] #* See [[#Hearts of the North|Hearts of the North]] # Exit [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]] to [[Ice Cliff Chasms]] to view [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 5 - Evennia Recruits the Ebon Vanguard|Evennia and the Ebon Vanguard]]. # Proceed to [[Lion's Arch Keep]] to see [[War in Kryta dialogues#Dialogue 6 - Captain Langmar Arrives in_Lion's Arch|Captain Langmar's arrival in Lion's Arch]]. This opens up: #* Possibility of [[War in Kryta#Ebon Falcons|Ebon Falcons allies]]. #* Random [[War in Kryta encounters#Encounter 10 - Langmar and Thackeray Assess the Recruits|dialogue]] in Shining Blade camp involving Lieutenant Thackeray. #* Random [[War in Kryta encounters#Encounter 15 - Old Men Jabbering: Holding the fort|dialogue]] in Lion's Arch Keep between 3 old men. # Next, complete the first three (required) bounties: [[Wanted: Inquisitor Lashona]], [[Wanted: Inquisitor Bauer]], and [[Wanted: Inquisitor Lovisa]]. Unlike the other [[Wanted!]] quests, these can only be completed once and are required. # Then, Salma will have a new chain of quests: ## [[Riverside Assassination]] ## [[A Little Help From Above]] ## [[Temple of the Intolerable]] ## [[Mustering a Response]] ## [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]], which completes the War in Kryta. # After completing [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]], go to the [[Hall of Monuments]] to see [[Hearts of the North dialogues#Dialogue 8 - Gwen's Unintended Promotion|the fate of Gwen]]. === [[Hearts of the North]] === If you have completed all of EotN ''or'' the [[Wintersday 2008#Quests|Wintersday Quests]] involving Gwen and Thackeray, you can view an additional 6 dialogues between Gwen and Thackeray # Visit the [[Hall of Monuments]] to begin the [[Hearts of the North|Gwen and Thackeray romance sequence]]. # Next, you can find [[Keiran Thackeray|Lieutenant Thackeray]] in [[Ice Cliff Chasms]] outside [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]]. He will send you on a [[Thackeray's scavenger hunt|scavenger hunt]] for picnic items, including something sweet, something to drink, an exotic meal, and candles. #* Ideally, give him 6 [[Votive Candle (post-Searing quest item)|Votive Candles]] , 1 [[Birthday Cupcake]], 1 [[Drake Kabob]] and 1 [[Hard Apple Cider]] or a combination of various [[Thackeray's scavenger hunt#Other_Items|other items]]. # After giving him the last item, return to the Hall of Monuments for one more dialogue between the two Ebon Vanguard soldiers. #* This also unlocks Evennia's recruitment of the Ebon Vanguard. #* After this dialogue, the scavenger hunt ends and you will no longer be able to collect [[Paper Wrapped Parcel]]s or [[Sack of Random Junk|Sacks of Random Junk]]. == Notes == * You can start the War in Kryta with the dialogues at the Shining Blade Camp. However, you will have to return there to recruit Zinn after his trial, making it more efficient to start the sequence with the Trial of Zinn. * You can skip the Gwen & Thackeray dialogues and still complete WiK. However, you will not see any Ebon Vanguard allies or participate in the picnic scavenger hunt. ** You may return to the Hall of Monuments with someone else who needs to unlock the Gwen & Thackeray sequence, which will allow you to participate in the Picnic. ** Similarly, you need to return to Lion's Arch Keep with someone who needs to witness Captain Langmar's arrival, otherwise you will not have access to the Ebon Vanguard recruits for the War or for the Shining Blade Bounties. == War in Kryta follow-up == * After completing The Battle for Lion's Arch, ''most'' of Kryta will return to its pre-WiK state: ** Explorable areas no longer spawn WiK foes ** [[Courier Falken]] and the various allies will no longer spawn. * These areas remain available: ** [[Lion's Arch Keep]] (and the associated collectors and Wanted! quests) ** [[Divinity Coast (explorable area)]], [[Riverside Province (explorable area)]], and [[D'Alessio Seaboard (explorable area)]]. * If you have ''any'' Wanted! quest active, ''all'' explorable areas in Kryta will return to their WiK state, including the associated foes and allies.
